development.command: npm ci && npx expo prebuild --platform android --no-install && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug

preview.command: npm ci && npx expo prebuild --platform android --no-install && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease

development.command: npm ci && npx expo prebuild --platform ios --no-install && cd ios && pod install && xcodebuild -workspace DandoEv.xcworkspace -scheme DandoEv -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=- -derivedDataPath build

preview.command: npm ci && npx expo prebuild --platform ios --no-install && cd ios && pod install && xcodebuild -workspace DandoEv.xcworkspace -scheme DandoEv -configuration Release -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=- -derivedDataPath build
